summary: FRONTEND validation of expanded CTE DB-SI (SI 1..SI 6) inside the unified INCENDIOS module. All 4 P0 scenarios PASS: (1) DB-SI wizard 'Datos del edificio' renders every new field (uso, superficie_construida, altura_evacuacion, sentido_evacuacion, num_salidas, ancho_salidas_proyectado, recorrido_max_real, distancia_colindantes, local_riesgo_especial, bajo_rasante, vial_aproximacion_ok) with correct control types (select/select/select for enums, switches for booleans); Ocupación step adds zones and shows total (910). (2) Resultados renders DbsiResultsPanel with SIX section cards data-testid dbsi-seccion-SI1..SI6, each with estado badge, key/value rows, SI 4 shows 10 installations (dbsi-inst-0..9), global badge shows 'No cumple', 3 observaciones. Coherence with the seeded Comercial (dist=2, ancho=3.5, 910 ocup) is correct: SI 2 'No cumple', SI 3 'No cumple', SI 1 'Cumple', SI 4/5/6 'Informativo', global 'No cumple' — Observaciones match (SI2 huecos EI/retranqueo; SI3 3.50<4.55). (3) Report page /estudios/{id}/informe renders ámbito_header 'Centro comercial · Edificación · CTE DB-SI', Ocupación table (2 zonas + total 910), SI 1..SI 6 as keyvalue sections, SI 4 as instalaciones list, reference tables (SI1, SI3, SI6) with highlighted rows/cells (11 highlighted cells), Observaciones, and 'Descargar PDF' print button (data-testid print-report). (4) Mixed regression (seeded study 6a5e8d366baf3a93ee959a97) still renders both ambitos: RSCIEI ResultsPanel for 'Nave A' (industrial) and the new SI1-SI6 DbsiResultsPanel for 'Oficinas' (edificacion) in the same incendios-results-panel; each ámbito is its own wizard step. No console errors, no broken selectors.
critical_code_review_comments: DbsiResultsPanel.jsx is compact and correct; suggestion (non-blocking): SEC_LABEL uses 'Con observaciones' for estado 'observaciones' but the engine now emits only cumple|no_cumple|info, so the observaciones branch is dead — harmless.

Route is /estudios/:studyId (Spanish). Iteration-9 context note said 'PUT /api/studies/{id}' — for the FE study page the correct URL prefix is /estudios (matches App.js). Documenting for future agents.
